text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Bouquet-san, thank you very much for the 
lovely gift of flowers and plants this 
morning.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Open the window, let the breeze through, 
and the decorated plants and flowers 
release their fragrance. A soft floral 
wind that blows only in that room...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It felt as though my whole body was being 
gently embraced by a spring breeze.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it was just a modest little 
surprise, but seeing you so happy makes me 
glad.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Still, that flower-scented breeze... It 
feels somewhat familiar. Could it be—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Did you notice? Actually— I looked 
into the native flora of Zephyr-san's 
hometown—and prepared those plants.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I thought... feeling a breeze reminiscent 
of your homeland might bring you the most 
peace.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No wonder. Indeed—crocuses, hyacinths, 
and—ah, azaleas as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It must be because it was paired with your 
profound, spring-breeze-like kindness that 
my heart felt so at ease, Bouquet-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah, having it put that way again is a 
little embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, won't you join me sometime? 
To bathe in the fragrant breeze of my 
homeland together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...! I'm so glad. I'll be looking 
forward to the day I can visit.
